notes: Night Knight shows the time and your CPU and GPU on every screen shape, round screens included, and after the portal reloads.
Your Forge placements hold: a reading stays where you put it, even when it arrives after the look has loaded.
Readings fade in once they are placed, so nothing jumps on start.
Ganymede Simple: a clean start page in Forge, and every Ganymede layout keeps its rows lined up with no empty cards.
Text sizes follow one shared scale on every theme.
